contentPattern.structure: circular avatar image + name (H3) + role/tags (H5) + social-icon links

suitableFor: author or guide directories with a photo, name, role and social links
any repeating people card where the avatar is circular and content is centered
notSuitableFor: article / feature / product teaser grids with rectangular cover images and descriptions (use vanilla cards)
single promotional banners (use a hero variant)

distinctFrom.cards: Vanilla 'cards' renders bordered rectangular cards with a 4:3 cover image on top and a left-aligned heading + description. cards-team is a borderless people/team treatment: circular avatar (1:1, border-radius 50%), centered name + uppercase role line, and a centered inline row of social-icon links. Same content model (image cell | text cell per card) but a distinct visual purpose, so a new variant was created rather than restyling vanilla cards. The magazine article grid (coverage gap) keeps using vanilla cards.
